# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c11 P25](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0025), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a young boy with a dark, gloomy face and black eyes that can fill with enmity or tears.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

## Personality

Anthony possesses a dark, sullen, and defiant demeanor. He is initially rebellious toward authority and unimpressed by attempts to teach him gentility, responding to lectures with silence or a contemptuous whistle. However, he respects physical discipline and straightforward firmness, holding a high opinion of female strength when proven.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- defiant  <sub>[v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)</sub>
- respectful of physical strength  <sub>[v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk attended Brierley school, where he sat alone at a corner desk and exhibited an hostile, sullen attitude toward his teacher, Nell Harcourt. During class, he once poured the remaining water from his slate bottle down the back of Aurelia Clay's neck. When kept in during recess for a lecture on gentlemanly behavior, he remained entirely unmoved and whistled contemptuously upon leaving. On a later occasion, after misbehaving in class, Nell lost her temper and whipped him across the palms with a pointer, causing his defiance to break into tears. Following the whipping, Anthony's attitude shifted completely; he came to respect Nell, remarking that she had some worth despite being a girl and noting that the beating he received from her was as good as a man's. Afterwards, he pardoned her, greeted her politely on the road, and offered to carry her schoolbooks through the snow.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
